Future<void> process(Object? x) async {}
Future<void> processAll(List<int> xs) async {}

// CASE dart_commented_out_loop expect=pass
Future<void> d1(List<int> items) async {
  // for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
  //   await process(items[i]);
  // }
  await processAll(items);
}

// CASE dart_block_commented_loop expect=pass
Future<void> d2(List<int> items) async {
  /*
  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    await process(items[i]);
  }
  */
  await processAll(items);
}

// CASE dart_doc_sample expect=pass
/// Saves all items at once.
///
/// Before this helper we wrote `for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) await save(i);`.
Future<void> d3(List<int> items) async {
  await processAll(items);
}

// CASE dart_line_comment_no_brace expect=pass
Future<void> d4(List<int> items) async {
  // Used to be: for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) await process(items[i]);
  await processAll(items);
}
